name: Kijima Toru
source:
Executive of Kijima System Co., Ltd.

Brother-in-law of Tokunori's eldest son, Hika.
As the next president, he currently works for Tokunori.
He has a similar approach to his father and is known as the second strong man.

[Translated from [url=https://www.guilty-soft.com/product/torikonoshimai/chara6.html]the official site[/url]]
